# Line-range comments: data model, server validation and prompt ranges

## What to build

Human review comments (the human review round, `humanReview: true`) today anchor to at most one new-side line (`line`). This slice makes a comment anchor to a **range on one side** of the diff, end to end through the API and the agent prompts, with no UI change yet.

- `commentSchema` in `src/review/human.ts` gains optional `side` (`"new" | "old"`), `startLine` and `endLine`. The old `line` field stays as a legacy alias: a comment with `line` and no `startLine` is normalized on read to `{side: "new", startLine: line, endLine: line}`, so old `human/round<H>.json` files and old API bodies keep working.
- Both servers (`src/web/server.ts` `POST /review/comments` and `src/suite/server.ts` `POST /api/review/comments`) accept the new fields and validate them.
- `commentFindings`, the fixer prompt (`src/agents/fixer.ts` `humanSection`), the code reviewer prompt (`src/agents/reviewer.ts`) and the live-check cases (`liveCheckCases`) all show the range as `file new L12–L18` / `file old L40–L42` (a one-line range shows as `new L18`).
- `findingSchema` in `src/review/report.ts` gains optional `endLine` and `side` so the range survives in the finding.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/review/human.ts` (lines 9–19): `commentSchema`, which this slice extends.
- `src/review/human.ts` (lines 43–61): `loadHumanRound` / `saveHumanRound`. Both parse with `humanRoundSchema`, so the normalization must live in the schema.
- `src/review/human.ts` (lines 81–108): `commentFindingId`, `commentFindings`, `applyCommentVerdicts`. Today `failureScenario` is `${file}:${line}\n${snippet}`.
- `src/review/human.ts` (lines 157–255): `HumanReviewStore`, with the `serial()` queue (162–166) and `add(input)` (186–197). `add` throws `HumanReviewError("line needs a file")`, then `commentSchema.safeParse`.
- `src/review/human.ts` (lines 263–280): `liveCheckCases`. The step text is `Exercise the behavior of ${c.file}${c.line ? ` around line ${c.line}` : ""}`.
- `src/review/report.ts` (lines 11–21): `findingSchema`. Lines 108–154 hold `coerceReport` (line coercion at 121, `toInt` at 91). Line 297 is the `renderMarkdown` location string.
- `src/agents/fixer.ts` (lines 67–90): `renderFinding` (location at 68) and `humanSection`. `fence` is imported from `./reviewer.js` (line 10).
- `src/agents/reviewer.ts` (lines 127–139): the human comments block of `codeReviewerPrompt`.
- `src/web/server.ts` (lines 268–302): the local `newCommentSchema` and `commentWrite` (the `line needs a file` check is at 292–293; `HumanReviewError` maps to 404 for kind `unknown`, otherwise 400).
- `src/suite/server.ts` (lines 74–82, 117–140): the suite's own copy of `newCommentSchema` and `commentWrite`.
- `src/review/human.test.ts`: test style. The fixture `setup()` is at lines 8–12, and the commentFindings tests at 54–68 use `const base = { round: 1, liveCheck: false, followUps: [] as string[] }`.
- `src/web/server.test.ts` (lines 387–501): `describe("review comments")` with `setupComments()` and the `send(method, path, body)` helper.
- `src/suite/server.test.ts` (lines 181–270): `describe("suite review routes")` with `reviewSetup()`.
- `src/review/phase.test.ts` (lines 967–988, 1080): asserts the fixer and reviewer prompts contain `## Human review comments` and `human-H1-1`.

## Patterns to follow

**Schema with normalization (zod).** Keep the parsed type usable everywhere `Comment` is used today:
```ts
const commentBase = z.object({
  id: z.string().regex(/^H\d+-\d+$/),
  round: z.number().int().min(1),
  file: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  side: z.enum(["new", "old"]).optional(),
  startLine: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),
  endLine: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),
  line: z.number().int().min(1).optional(), // legacy: one new-side line
  snippet: z.string().max(2000).optional(),
  body: z.string().trim().min(1).max(10_000),
  liveCheck: z.boolean().default(false),
  status: z.enum(["open", "resolved", "reopened"]).default("open"),
  followUps: z.array(z.string().min(1)).default([]),
});
export const commentSchema = commentBase
  .transform(({ line, ...c }) =>
    line !== undefined && c.startLine === undefined ? { ...c, side: "new" as const, startLine: line, endLine: line } : c.startLine !== undefined ? { ...c, side: c.side ?? "new", endLine: c.endLine ?? c.startLine } : c)
  .superRefine((c, ctx) => { /* startLine needs file; endLine >= startLine; endLine - startLine <= 500 */ });
```
The transform drops `line`, so saved files are always written in the new shape. Every reader (`c.line`) must switch to `c.startLine`/`c.endLine`/`c.side`. Search with `grep -rn "\.line\b" src/review src/agents src/web src/suite`. Findings keep their own `line` field.

**One range formatter, reused.** Add it to `src/review/human.ts`:
```ts
/** "new L12–L18", "old L40", or "" when the comment has no lines. */
export const rangeLabel = (c: Pick<Comment, "side" | "startLine" | "endLine">): string =>
  c.startLine === undefined ? "" : `${c.side ?? "new"} L${c.startLine}${c.endLine && c.endLine !== c.startLine ? `–L${c.endLine}` : ""}`;
```

**Error handling.** Store-level errors throw `HumanReviewError(message)` (kind `invalid` → HTTP 400). Messages are short and lowercase, as today: `"line needs a file"`, `"endLine before startLine"`, `"range too long"`.

**Tests.** vitest with `describe`/`it`/`expect`. Build comments literally, as in `human.test.ts:54-68`, and drive the servers through the existing `send()` helpers.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/review/human.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: the `commentSchema` above (base object, transform, superRefine). The superRefine issues are:
  - `startLine` without `file` → message `line needs a file`
  - `endLine < startLine` → `endLine before startLine`
  - `endLine - startLine > 500` → `range too long`

  `humanRoundSchema` keeps using `commentSchema`, so loading a legacy file normalizes it.
- **IMPLEMENT**: export `rangeLabel`.
- **IMPLEMENT**: change the `add(input)` signature to `{ file?, side?, startLine?, endLine?, line?, snippet?, body, liveCheck? }`. Keep the `line needs a file` pre-check for both `line` and `startLine`, then `commentSchema.safeParse`.
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `commentFindings`, set `line: c.startLine`, `endLine: c.endLine` and `side: c.side` when present. Change `failureScenario` to:

  ```ts
  `${c.file} ${rangeLabel(c)}`.trim() + "\n" + (c.snippet ?? "")
  ```

  then `.trim()`. A file-only comment stays `"a.ts"`, and a general comment stays `"general comment on the whole change"`.
- **IMPLEMENT**: change the `liveCheckCases` step to `Exercise the behavior of ${c.file}${c.startLine ? ` around ${rangeLabel(c)}` : ""}`.
- **GOTCHA**: `z.infer` of a transformed schema is the output type. Export `type Comment = z.output<typeof commentSchema>` and `type CommentInput = z.input<typeof commentSchema>`. `saveHumanRound` re-parses with `humanRoundSchema.parse(data)`. Passing already-normalized comments through the transform again must be a no-op: `line` is undefined and `startLine` is set.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/review/report.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: add `endLine: z.number().int().optional()` and `side: z.enum(["new", "old"]).optional()` to `findingSchema`. In `coerceReport`, coerce `endLine` like `line` (line 121, using `toInt`). Make the `renderMarkdown` location (line 297):

  ```ts
  `${f.file}${f.line !== undefined ? `:${f.line}${f.endLine && f.endLine !== f.line ? `-${f.endLine}` : ""}` : ""}`
  ```
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review/report`

### UPDATE `src/agents/fixer.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `humanSection`, change the location to:

  ```ts
  const where = c.file ? ` \`${c.file}\`${c.startLine ? ` ${c.side === "old" ? "old" : "new"} lines ${c.startLine}${c.endLine !== c.startLine ? `–${c.endLine}` : ""}` : ""}` : "";
  ```

  For `side === "old"`, push one more line: `  (These lines were removed by the change; the reviewer is commenting on the removal.)`. In `renderFinding` (line 68), show `:${line}-${endLine}` when `endLine` differs.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/agents/reviewer.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in the human comments block (lines 127–139), use the same location text as the fixer. Extract a small exported helper `commentWhere(c)` in `src/agents/fixer.ts` or `src/review/human.ts`, and use it from both prompts, so the two never drift.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/web/server.ts` and `src/suite/server.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: extend both `newCommentSchema` copies with:

  ```ts
  side: z.enum(["new","old"]).optional(),
  startLine: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),
  endLine: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),
  ```

  Keep `line`. In both `commentWrite` helpers, extend the `line needs a file` check to `startLine`. Range errors reach the client as 400 through the existing `HumanReviewError` mapping.
- **GOTCHA**: the `GET /review` and `GET /api/review` responses return `allComments(...)`, which already passed through `loadHumanRound`. They therefore contain `side`/`startLine`/`endLine` and never `line`. Do not add `line` back.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server src/suite/server`

### UPDATE tests

- `src/review/human.test.ts`:
  - a legacy comment `{..., file: "a.ts", line: 4}` parses to `{side:"new", startLine:4, endLine:4}` with no `line`
  - a round file written with `line` loads (`loadHumanRound`) normalized
  - `add({file, side:"old", startLine:40, endLine:42, snippet, body})` saves the range
  - `add` rejects `endLine before startLine`, `range too long`, and `startLine` without a file
  - `commentFindings` gives `failureScenario` `"a.ts new L12–L18\nx()"` and `"a.ts old L40\ny"`, and `line`/`endLine`/`side` on the finding
  - `liveCheckCases` step text
- `src/web/server.test.ts` (`describe("review comments")`):
  - POST `{file:"a.txt", side:"new", startLine:2, endLine:3, snippet:"two\nthree", body:"x"}` → 201, and GET /review returns those fields
  - the legacy POST `{file:"a.txt", line:3, ...}` still works and is returned as `startLine:3`
  - `{startLine:3, endLine:2}` → 400
- `src/suite/server.test.ts`: one range comment through `/api/review/comments` → 201 with the fields.
- `src/review/phase.test.ts` (around line 967): the existing prompt tests still pass. Add an assertion that a range comment's fixer prompt contains `new lines 2–3`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review src/web/server src/suite/server src/agents`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `POST /review/comments` and `POST /api/review/comments` accept `{file, side, startLine, endLine, snippet, body, liveCheck}` → 201 with the saved comment
- [ ] Legacy `{file, line}` bodies → 201, stored as `side:"new", startLine=endLine=line`; legacy round files load the same way
- [ ] 400 for `startLine` without `file` (`line needs a file`), `endLine before startLine`, `range too long` (> 500 lines)
- [ ] The fixer prompt shows ``- **human-H1-1** `a.ts` new lines 12–18: …``, and old-side comments add the removal note
- [ ] The code reviewer prompt uses the same location text
- [ ] Findings carry `line`/`endLine`/`side`, and `failureScenario` is `file new L12–L18\n<snippet>`
- [ ] Every existing test passes: `npm test`

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/review src/agents src/web/server src/suite/server
npm test
```
